title: Squares, One Line
prompt: Implement squares(n) that returns the squares of 1..n as a list, using a list comprehension (no append, no loop variable bookkeeping).

tests.name: squares first five
tests.hint: Each element should be i*i for i in 1..n.

tests.name: squares of zero
tests.hint: Edge case: n=0 → empty list. A comprehension over an empty range yields [].
